gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes classifying the method used to evaluate pile/element compressive resistance from a high-strain dynamic (hammer impact) load test. Used for the value of diggs:DynamicLoadTestType/testMethod. Spans EN ISO 22477-4's four named methods and adds signal_matching for the CAPWAP-style companion analysis US practice under ASTM D4945 names as a distinct step from the base impact measurement.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Dynamic Load Test Method Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Resistance evaluated from measurements of strain and acceleration (or displacement) at the element head during hammer impact. ASTM D4945; EN ISO 22477-4 method (a).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Dynamic Impact Testing

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Resistance evaluated by matching a computed wave-equation response to the measured force and velocity records from a dynamic impact test, adjusting the soil model until the match is acceptable - CAPWAP or an equivalent signal-matching analysis. The near-universal companion analysis to ASTM D4945 dynamic impact testing in US practice; a form of wave equation analysis under EN ISO 22477-4.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Signal Matching

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Resistance evaluated from blow count and hammer energy during driving using an empirical driving formula. EN ISO 22477-4 method (b).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Driving Formula

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Resistance evaluated from blow count by modelling the pile/element, ground and driving equipment as a wave-propagation system. EN ISO 22477-4 method (c). Distinct from signal_matching, which fits a wave-equation model to MEASURED force and velocity records rather than predicting resistance from blow count alone.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Wave Equation Analysis

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Resistance evaluated from a series of blows producing different levels of element head displacement and velocity. EN ISO 22477-4 method (d).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Multi-Blow Dynamic Testing
